actions.title: Inspect without changing state
actions.instruction: Choose Inspect in the Academy console. Read the repository path, Git state, current branch, attempt, origin, and upstream before taking another action.
actions.rationale: One read-only report keeps repository diagnosis separate from recovery changes.
actions.expected_result: Inspect reports each repository boundary and makes no repository change.
actions.recovery: If Inspect cannot identify a Git repository, stop and return to the Repository not found decision above.
actions.evidence: The report records the state you observed before recovery.

actions.title: Read the authoritative lesson result
actions.instruction: Choose Check in the Academy console only after Inspect identifies the intended numbered attempt.
actions.rationale: The installed Academy checker evaluates the selected repository as untrusted input.
actions.expected_result: Check either passes or names the exact unmet lesson requirement.
actions.recovery: If there is no prepared attempt, return to the lesson and Prepare once. If Check fails, preserve the report and follow that lesson's recovery text.
actions.evidence: The Check report belongs with the numbered attempt.

actions.title: Create the next documented attempt
actions.instruction: Choose Reset only after the current attempt evidence is committed, the worktree is clean, and the remotes are safe.
actions.rationale: Reset keeps the failed attempt and creates the next numbered attempt through one bounded operation.
actions.expected_result: The console reports the archived attempt and the next prepared attempt number.
actions.recovery: If Reset refuses, keep the current state, run Inspect, and resolve only the condition it reports.
actions.evidence: Both numbered attempt branches remain available.

actions.title: Return to the course base
actions.instruction: Choose Return to base after Inspect reports committed evidence and a clean attempt worktree.
actions.rationale: The console can verify the preservation conditions before leaving the attempt.
actions.expected_result: The console reports main as the current branch and no local changes while the attempt branch still exists.
actions.recovery: If Return to base refuses, keep the attempt open and resolve only the preservation condition named by the console.
actions.evidence: The attempt branch and evidence commits remain reachable after returning to main.
